title: Detailed sushi roll
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- plate -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='38' ry='10' fill='#2d4a6b'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='76' rx='36' ry='9' fill='#3d6a9b'/>
  <!-- nori outer ring -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='30' ry='26' fill='#1a2a4a'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='27' ry='23' fill='#22355c'/>
  <!-- rice ring -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='25' ry='21' fill='#e8e0d0'/>
  <!-- filling: salmon -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='12' ry='14' fill='#f47b5e'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='9' ry='11' fill='#ff9b80'/>
  <!-- cucumber -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='50' rx='5' ry='6' fill='#3da85a'/>
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='50' rx='3' ry='4' fill='#6fd88a'/>
  <!-- avocado -->
  <ellipse cx='56' cy='60' rx='5' ry='5' fill='#8bc34a'/>
  <ellipse cx='56' cy='60' rx='3' ry='3' fill='#b8e06a'/>
  <!-- tuna -->
  <ellipse cx='55' cy='49' rx='4' ry='4' fill='#c94a4a'/>
  <ellipse cx='55' cy='49' rx='2.5' ry='2.5' fill='#e87070'/>
  <!-- rice grain details -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='48' r='1.5' fill='#f5f0e8'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='48' r='1.5' fill='#f5f0e8'/>
  <circle cx='33' cy='58' r='1.5' fill='#f5f0e8'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='58' r='1.5' fill='#f5f0e8'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='78' r='1.5' fill='#f5f0e8'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='53' r='1.5' fill='#f5f0e8'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='53' r='1.5' fill='#f5f0e8'/>
  <!-- nori highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='28' ry='24' fill='none' stroke='#3a5080' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- chopsticks -->
  <rect x='12' y='30' width='4' height='40' rx='2' fill='#d4a06a' transform='rotate(-15 14 50)'/>
  <rect x='18' y='30' width='4' height='40' rx='2' fill='#c49058' transform='rotate(-10 20 50)'/>
  <!-- wasabi dollop -->
  <ellipse cx='80' cy='70' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#8fbc5a'/>
  <ellipse cx='80' cy='69' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#b8d88a'/>
  <!-- ginger slices -->
  <ellipse cx='22' cy='70' rx='7' ry='3.5' fill='#f0b8b8' transform='rotate(-20 22 70)'/>
  <ellipse cx='24' cy='73' rx='6' ry='3' fill='#f5caca' transform='rotate(-10 24 73)'/>
</svg>
